summary: BHP Group Ltd filed this Form 6-K to update the market on Jansen Stage 2 Potash Project cost and schedule estimates. The total investment estimate increased from US$4.9 billion to US$6.9 billion (including contingencies), with first production estimated in late FY2031. The project was originally approved in October 2023 and extended by two years in August 2025. The cost increase is driven by additional construction hours, materials, and escalation. Jansen Stage 2 is 16% complete with engineering at 83%. BHP expects an impairment charge of approximately US$2.3 billion before and after tax. This filing is a routine project update with no special situation event.
